status_vocabulary.fixed_on_main: fix merged to public main with a passing test
status_vocabulary.fixed_on_local_branch: fix exists only on the unpublished research branch
status_vocabulary.expected_failure_known_gap: strict-xfail test proves the gap still exists
status_vocabulary.verified_by_ai_check: claimed behaviour held in an AI-operated check (not an independent human review)
status_vocabulary.untested_inference: from code reading or configuration only
status_vocabulary.documented_mismatch: docs and code disagree; proposed wording not applied
status_vocabulary.documented_limit: known limitation, intended or accepted pending review
status_vocabulary.partial_check: checked within a stated narrow scope only
status_vocabulary.unresolved_human_input: needs factual input from a person
status_vocabulary.user_reported_review: user reports a review occurred; contents not checked
status_vocabulary.verified_individual_decision: a person's actual decision, received and recorded (none yet)

claims.claim: Agent shell commands in default local mode cannot reach company secrets (vault, saved API key) or system paths.

claims.next_action: P-04: keep secrets outside the agent-reachable tree or make Docker the default for real providers; flip xfails when fixed.

claims.claim: Git metadata and hooks in the workspace cannot be altered by agent commands to run code on the host.

claims.next_action: P-05: run company git with core.hooksPath disabled and keep .git out of (or read-only in) the agent mount; acceptance test = the xfail passes in local and Docker mode.
